The proposed stack used React.js and Next.js for the interface, Solidity smart contracts deployed on Ethereum, IPFS for patient-record storage, and Web3 with MetaMask for user interaction and transaction signing. The user requested research-paper and journal-paper wording and a methodology paragraph, then explicitly clarified that the paragraph should not include encryption of data stored on IPFS. The project remained a proposed paper/system description; no implementation outcome was reported. The requests and refinement occurred on the same day.
